decisions.reason: Readable says what the east wind scatters and uses the English phrase "turn my back on", which carries the same picture as the Hebrew (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "je leur tournerai le dos" (R), with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: French "tourner le dos à" carries the same picture as the Hebrew without a possessive, so Readable has no span where the English has "my back".

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ לְכ֨וּ וְנַחְשְׁבָ֣ה עַֽל־יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת֒ כִּי֩ לֹא־תֹאבַ֨ד תּוֹרָ֜ה מִכֹּהֵ֗ן וְעֵצָה֙ מֵֽחָכָ֔ם וְדָבָ֖ר מִנָּבִ֑יא לְכוּ֙ וְנַכֵּ֣הוּ בַלָּשׁ֔וֹן וְאַל־נַקְשִׁ֖יבָה אֶל־כָּל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said, Come and let us devise against Jeremiah plans, for not will perish instruction from [the] priest, and counsel from [the] wise, and [the] word from [the] prophet. Come and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words.

en.L: Then they said, "Come, and let us devise plans against Jeremiah, for instruction will not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not pay attention to any of his words."
en.B: Then they said, "Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah. Instruction will never be lost to the priest, or counsel to the wise, or the word to the prophet. Come, let us attack him with words and pay no attention to anything he says."
en.R: Then some of the people said, "Come on, let us make plans against Jeremiah. We will still have priests to give us teaching, wise people to give us advice, and prophets to give us God's message. Come, let us attack him with our words. We will not listen to anything he says."

es.L: Entonces dijeron: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y tramemos planes contra Jeremías, porque no faltará la instrucción al sacerdote, ni el consejo al sabio, ni la palabra al profeta. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y hirámoslo con la lengua, y no prestemos atención a ninguna de sus palabras».
es.B: Entonces dijeron: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, hagamos planes contra Jeremías. Nunca faltará la instrucción del sacerdote, ni el consejo del sabio, ni la palabra del profeta. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, ataquémoslo con palabras y no hagamos caso de nada de lo que diga».
es.R: Entonces algunos del pueblo dijeron: «Vamos, hagamos planes contra Jeremías. Seguiremos teniendo sacerdotes que nos enseñen, sabios que nos aconsejen y profetas que nos den el mensaje de Dios. Vamos, ataquémoslo con nuestras palabras. No escucharemos nada de lo que diga».

fr.L: Alors ils dirent : « Venez, et formons des projets contre Jérémie, car la loi ne se perdra pas chez le prêtre, ni le conseil chez le sage, ni la parole chez le prophète. Venez, et frappons-le avec la langue, et ne prêtons attention à aucune de ses paroles. »
fr.B: Alors ils dirent : « Venez, formons des projets contre Jérémie. L’instruction ne manquera jamais au prêtre, ni le conseil au sage, ni la parole au prophète. Venez, attaquons-le avec des paroles, et ne faisons aucune attention à ce qu’il dit. »
fr.R: Alors certains ont dit : « Venez, faisons des projets contre Jérémie. Nous aurons toujours des prêtres pour nous enseigner, des sages pour nous conseiller et des prophètes pour nous donner le message de Dieu. Venez, attaquons-le avec nos paroles. Nous n’écouterons rien de ce qu’il dit. »

sw.L: Ndipo wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia, kwa maana sheria haitapotea kwa kuhani, wala shauri kwa mwenye hekima, wala neno kwa nabii. Njooni, tumpige kwa ulimi, wala tusiyasikilize maneno yake yoyote."
sw.B: Ndipo wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia. Mafundisho hayatakosekana kwa kuhani, wala shauri kwa wenye hekima, wala neno kwa nabii. Njooni, tumshambulie kwa maneno, tusijali lolote analosema."
sw.R: Ndipo baadhi ya watu wakasema, "Njooni, tufanye mipango dhidi ya Yeremia. Bado tutakuwa na makuhani wa kutufundisha, wenye hekima wa kutushauri, na manabii wa kutuletea ujumbe wa Mungu. Njooni, tumshambulie kwa maneno yetu. Hatutasikiliza lolote analosema."

vi.L: Bấy giờ chúng nói: "Hãy đến, và chúng ta hãy bày mưu nghịch cùng Giê-rê-mi, vì luật pháp sẽ không mất khỏi thầy tế lễ, mưu lược [không mất] khỏi người khôn ngoan, và lời [không mất] khỏi nhà tiên tri. Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy dùng lưỡi đánh hắn, và đừng để ý đến bất cứ lời nào của hắn."
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng nói: "Nào, chúng ta hãy bày mưu hại Giê-rê-mi. Thầy tế lễ sẽ không bao giờ thiếu luật pháp, người khôn ngoan không thiếu mưu lược, nhà tiên tri không thiếu lời. Nào, chúng ta hãy dùng lời nói mà tấn công hắn, và đừng để ý gì đến những điều hắn nói."
vi.R: Bấy giờ có người nói: "Nào, chúng ta hãy lập mưu hại Giê-rê-mi. Chúng ta vẫn còn các thầy tế lễ dạy dỗ, những người khôn ngoan khuyên bảo, và các nhà tiên tri truyền sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời. Nào, chúng ta hãy dùng lời nói mà tấn công hắn. Chúng ta sẽ không thèm nghe điều gì hắn nói."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 칠 계획을 꾸미자. 제사장에게서 가르침이, 지혜로운 자에게서 조언이, 예언자에게서 말씀이 끊어지지 않을 것이다. 자, 혀로 그를 치고, 그의 어떤 말에도 귀를 기울이지 말자."
ko.B: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 해칠 계획을 세우자. 제사장에게 가르침이, 지혜로운 사람에게 조언이, 예언자에게 말씀이 없어질 리가 없다. 자, 말로 그를 공격하고, 그가 하는 말에는 조금도 귀를 기울이지 말자."
ko.R: 그러자 몇몇 사람이 말했다. "자, 예레미야를 해칠 계획을 세우자. 우리에게는 여전히 가르침을 줄 제사장들이 있고, 조언을 해 줄 지혜로운 사람들이 있고, 하나님의 말씀을 전해 줄 예언자들이 있다. 자, 말로 그를 공격하자. 그가 하는 말은 하나도 듣지 말자."

decisions.choice: the start of Jeremiah's fourth lament: the plot against him and his prayer about it
decisions.reason: Verses 18-23 are the fourth of Jeremiah's prayers of complaint to God (11:18-12:6; 15:10-21; 17:14-18; 18:18-23; 20:7-18). Verse 18 tells the plot in prose; in verses 19-23 Jeremiah turns to God in poetry, much as the psalms of lament do.

decisions.choice: they said: Jeremiah's opponents, not named
decisions.reason: The speakers are not named. They are among the people who said they would follow their own plans (verse 12), probably including the priests, wise men and prophets they speak of. Their "plans" against Jeremiah answer God's "plan" against Judah (verse 11).

decisions.choice: instruction from the priest, counsel from the wise, the word from the prophet: the three kinds of guidance Israel relied on
decisions.reason: Priests taught God's instruction, wise men gave advice, and prophets brought God's word (Ezekiel 7:26 names the same three). The plotters mean that they can do without Jeremiah, and that his warnings that these leaders would fail (4:9; 8:8-10) are false.

decisions.choice: strike him with the tongue: attack him with words
alternatives: strike him because of his tongue
decisions.reason: The tongue as a weapon means slander, false charges or a case brought against him in court (9:2, 7; Psalm 64:4). The Hebrew could also be read "strike him for his tongue", that is, because of what he says; either way the attack is aimed at his message.

decisions.choice: let us not pay attention to any of his words: the Hebrew text
alternatives: let us listen closely to all his words
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation has no "not": "and let us listen to all his words", that is, watch what he says so as to catch him out (compare 20:10). The Hebrew text is followed here; both readings describe hostility to Jeremiah's message.

decisions.choice: instruction (Literal, Balanced); teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for this word in the prophets (see Isaiah). Here it is the priests' teaching of God's law.

decisions.choice: some of the people; We will still have priests ...; God's message
decisions.reason: Readable names the speakers loosely, as the Hebrew leaves them unnamed (meaning decision m2), and says what the saying about the priest, the wise and the prophet means.

decisions.choice: la instrucción (Literal, Balanced); que nos enseñen (Readable)
decisions.reason: The priest's *torah* is "instrucción" at Literal and Balanced and teaching at Readable, as the Psalms note sets it.

decisions.choice: sheria (Literal); mafundisho (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for *torah*: "sheria" at Literal, "mafundisho" (teaching) at Balanced and Readable, as the Psalms note.

decisions.choice: "la loi" (L); "l'instruction" (B); "pour nous enseigner" (R)
decisions.reason: Torah as the Psalms set it in French: "la loi" at Literal, "l'instruction" at Balanced, teaching at Readable.

decisions.choice: "luật pháp" (instruction, torah) at Literal and Balanced; "dạy dỗ" (teach) at Readable
decisions.reason: "Luật pháp" is the published Vietnamese word for torah given by priests; Readable turns it into what the priests do. The opponents speak of Jeremiah as "hắn", which shows their contempt.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for *torah*
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note and the English "instruction": the priest's teaching, not a code of law.

source.text: הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וּשְׁמַ֖ע לְק֥וֹל יְרִיבָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Give attention, Yahweh, to me, and listen to [the] voice of my opponents.

en.L: Pay attention, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, to me, \q and listen to the voice of my adversaries.
en.B: Pay attention to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and hear what my accusers are saying.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, listen to me! \q Hear what my enemies are saying about me.

es.L: Préstame atención, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y escucha la voz de mis adversarios.
es.B: Atiéndeme, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y oye lo que dicen mis acusadores.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escúchame! \q Oye lo que mis enemigos dicen de mí.

fr.L: Prête attention, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à moi, \q et écoute la voix de mes adversaires.
fr.B: Sois attentif à moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et entends ce que disent mes accusateurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute-moi ! \q Entends ce que mes ennemis disent de moi.

sw.L: Uniangalie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q uisikilize sauti ya wanaoshindana nami.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisikilize, \q usikie wanayosema wanaonishtaki.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nisikilize! \q Sikia maadui zangu wanayosema juu yangu.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin để ý đến con, \q và xin nghe tiếng của những kẻ chống đối con.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lưu tâm đến con, \q và xin nghe những điều kẻ kiện cáo con đang nói.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin lắng nghe con! \q Xin nghe những điều kẻ thù đang nói về con.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저에게 귀를 기울여 주십시오. \q 저와 다투는 자들의 목소리를 들어 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 돌아보아 주십시오. \q 저를 고발하는 자들이 하는 말을 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 말을 들어 주십시오! \q 제 원수들이 저에 대하여 하는 말을 들어 보십시오.

decisions.choice: pay attention, LORD: Jeremiah turns from the plotters to God
decisions.reason: Here the prayer of the lament begins (see verse 18, meaning decision m1). Jeremiah does not answer his enemies; he brings their words to God.

decisions.choice: my adversaries: those who contend with me, as in a lawsuit
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb for bringing a case against someone. Jeremiah's opponents are building a case against him (verse 18), and he asks God, the judge, to hear both sides (11:20; 12:1).

decisions.choice: LORD, addressed without "O"
decisions.reason: The divine name addressed directly has no "O", as in the Psalms and Isaiah.

decisions.choice: what my accusers are saying / what my enemies are saying about me
decisions.reason: "The voice of my adversaries" means what they say. Balanced uses "accusers" for the legal sense (m2); Readable uses the plainer "enemies".

decisions.choice: SEÑOR, addressed without "oh"
decisions.reason: God addressed by name takes no "oh", as in Psalm 19:15; this is the start of Jeremiah's prayer about the plot (verses 19-23).

decisions.choice: Ee BWANA
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the address to God with "Ee", as the published Psalms do, where the English has no "O".

decisions.choice: vocative "SEIGNEUR" without article or "ô", and "tu" to God; Jeremiah's lament is speech (passé composé, present)
decisions.reason: As the terms note: the vocative divine name takes no article; Jeremiah's prayers count as speech, so they never take the passé simple.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah prays "lạy CHÚA", calls himself "con" and God "Ngài"
decisions.reason: The prayer address settled in the terms note (Psalm 19:15; 2 Kings 19:15): the vocative is "lạy CHÚA", with no "O", the prophet is "con" and God is "Ngài", spanned in mid-sentence and written plainly at the start of a sentence or line. This holds for Jeremiah's laments in verses 19-23 and 20:7-18.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah prays in 합쇼체 with "저/제", addressing God as "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여"
decisions.reason: Verses 19-23 are Jeremiah's prayer, the fourth of his laments. As the terms note, prayers are in 합쇼체 and the vocative has no "오"; the shift from the plain narration of verse 18 marks that he now speaks to God.

source.text: הַיְשֻׁלַּ֤ם תַּֽחַת־טוֹבָה֙ רָעָ֔ה כִּֽי־כָר֥וּ שׁוּחָ֖ה לְנַפְשִׁ֑י זְכֹ֣ר׀עָמְדִ֣י לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְדַבֵּ֤ר עֲלֵיהֶם֙ טוֹבָ֔ה לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־חֲמָתְךָ֖ מֵהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Is repaid in place of good evil? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember my standing before you to speak on their behalf good, to turn back your wrath from them.

en.L: Should evil be repaid for good? \q Yet they have dug a pit for my life. \q Remember how I stood before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to speak good on their behalf, \q to turn back {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath from them.
en.B: Is evil the right return for good? \q Yet they have dug a pit to take my life. \q Remember how I stood before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and spoke up for their good, \q to turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath away from them.
en.R: Should anyone pay back good with evil? \q But they have dug a pit to trap me and kill me. \q Remember how I stood in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and asked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to be good to them. \q I asked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to stop being angry with them.

es.L: ¿Se paga mal por bien? \q Pues han cavado una fosa para mi vida. \q Acuérdate de cómo estuve delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para hablar bien en favor de ellos, \q para apartar de ellos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira.
es.B: ¿Es justo pagar el bien con el mal? \q Sin embargo, han cavado una fosa para quitarme la vida. \q Acuérdate de cómo me presenté delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} e intercedí por su bien, \q para apartar de ellos {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira.
es.R: ¿Acaso se debe pagar el bien con el mal? \q Pero ellos han cavado una fosa para atraparme y matarme. \q Acuérdate de cómo me presenté delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pedí que fueras bueno con ellos. \q También {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pedí que dejaras de estar enojado con ellos.

fr.L: Le mal sera-t-il rendu pour le bien ? \q Car ils ont creusé une fosse pour ma vie. \q Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je me suis tenu devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour dire du bien en leur faveur, \q pour détourner d’eux {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère.
fr.B: Faut-il rendre le mal pour le bien ? \q Pourtant ils ont creusé une fosse pour m’ôter la vie. \q Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} : je me suis tenu devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour plaider en leur faveur, \q pour détourner d’eux {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère.
fr.R: Est-ce qu’on doit répondre au bien par le mal ? \q Ils ont pourtant creusé un trou pour me piéger et me tuer. \q Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} : je suis venu devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai demandé d’être bon pour eux. \q Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai demandé de ne plus être en colère contre eux.

sw.L: Je, mabaya yalipwe badala ya mema? \q Lakini wameichimbia nafsi yangu shimo. \q Kumbuka jinsi nilivyosimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kusema mema kwa ajili yao, \q ili kuigeuza ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbali nao.
sw.B: Je, mabaya ndiyo malipo ya haki kwa mema? \q Hata hivyo wamenichimbia shimo ili wanitoe uhai. \q Kumbuka jinsi nilivyosimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nikawatetea wapate mema, \q ili kuiepusha ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbali nao.
sw.R: Je, mtu yeyote alipe mabaya kwa mema aliyotendewa? \q Lakini wamenichimbia shimo ili kuninasa na kuniua. \q Kumbuka jinsi nilivyosimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nikakuomba uwatendee mema. \q Nilikuomba uache kuwakasirikia.

vi.L: Lẽ nào lấy điều ác báo đáp điều thiện sao? \q Thế mà chúng đã đào hố cho mạng sống con. \q Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại con đã đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để nói điều tốt cho chúng, \q để làm cho cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi chúng.
vi.B: Lấy ác báo thiện như thế có phải lẽ không? \q Thế mà chúng đã đào hố để hại mạng sống con. \q Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại con đã đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cầu xin điều tốt cho chúng, \q để cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi chúng.
vi.R: Có ai lại lấy điều ác mà trả cho điều tốt không? \q Thế mà chúng đã đào hố để bẫy và giết con. \q Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ lại con đã đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban điều tốt cho chúng. \q Con đã xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thôi giận chúng.

ko.L: 선을 악으로 갚아도 됩니까? \q 그런데 그들이 제 목숨을 노려 구덩이를 팠습니다. \q 제가 주님 앞에 서서 그들을 위하여 좋은 말을 하여 \q 주님의 진노를 그들에게서 돌이키려 했던 것을 기억해 주십시오.
ko.B: 선을 악으로 갚는 것이 옳습니까? \q 그런데 그들은 제 목숨을 빼앗으려고 구덩이를 팠습니다. \q 제가 주님 앞에 서서 그들이 잘되도록 아뢰어 \q 주님의 진노를 그들에게서 거두시게 하려 했던 것을 기억해 주십시오.
ko.R: 선을 악으로 갚아도 되는 것입니까? \q 그런데 그들은 저를 잡아 죽이려고 구덩이를 팠습니다. \q 제가 주님 앞에 서서 그들에게 잘해 주시라고 간구했던 것을 기억해 주십시오. \q 그들에게 더 이상 노하지 마시라고 간구했습니다.

decisions.choice: they have dug a pit: they have set a trap, as hunters do
decisions.reason: Hunters dug pits and covered them to catch animals. The picture is used in the psalms for plots against the innocent (Psalm 7:16; 35:7; 57:7). Verse 22 repeats it.

decisions.choice: remember how I stood before you to speak good for them: Jeremiah's prayers for his people
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had pleaded with God for the people (14:7-9, 19-22), even when God told him not to (7:16; 11:14; 14:11). To "stand before" God is to serve him and plead with him, as Moses and Samuel did (15:1). The people now repay that with a plot to kill him.

decisions.choice: my life: the word often translated "soul"
decisions.reason: Here the word means Jeremiah's life itself: they want him dead.

decisions.choice: Should evil be repaid for good? / Is evil the right return for good?
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the form of the Hebrew question. Balanced asks the same question in natural English; both mean that Jeremiah is paid back with harm for the good he did.

decisions.choice: asked you to be good to them ... asked you to stop being angry
decisions.reason: Readable says what Jeremiah's speaking "good" for them and turning back God's wrath meant: he prayed for them.

decisions.choice: "Xin Ngài nhớ lại"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese prayer names the one asked; "Ngài" at the head of the clause is written plainly with its capital, as the style guide says for a pronoun beginning a sentence.

decisions.choice: "주님" for "you" in prayer
decisions.reason: Korean does not address God with a second-person pronoun; the prayer says "주님", as the published psalms do.

source.text: לָכֵן֩ תֵּ֨ן אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֜ם לָרָעָ֗ב וְהַגִּרֵם֮ עַל־יְדֵי־חֶרֶב֒ וְתִֽהְיֶ֨נָה נְשֵׁיהֶ֤ם שַׁכֻּלוֹת֙ וְאַלְמָנ֔וֹת וְאַ֨נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם יִֽהְי֖וּ הֲרֻ֣גֵי מָ֑וֶת בַּח֣וּרֵיהֶ֔ם מֻכֵּי־חֶ֖רֶב בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore give their children to the famine, and pour them out on [the] hands of [the] sword; and let be their wives bereaved and widows, and their men let them be slain [by] death, their young men struck [by the] sword in the battle.

en.L: Therefore give {{gender:their children|their sons}} over to famine, \q and hand them over to the power of the sword. \q Let their wives become childless and widows, \q and let their men be slain by death, \q their young men struck down by the sword in battle.
en.B: So hand {{gender:their children|their sons}} over to famine; \q give them up to the power of the sword. \q Let their wives be left childless and widowed, \q their men be killed by plague, \q and their young men be struck down by the sword in battle.
en.R: So let {{gender:their children|their sons}} starve to death. \q Let the rest of them be killed in war. \q Let their wives lose their children and their husbands. \q Let their men die of disease, \q and let their young men be killed in battle.

es.L: Por tanto, entrega a sus hijos al hambre, \q y entrégalos al poder de la espada. \q Que sus mujeres queden sin hijos y viudas, \q y que sus hombres mueran a manos de la muerte, \q sus jóvenes heridos a espada en la batalla.
es.B: Por eso, entrega a sus hijos al hambre; \q abandónalos al poder de la espada. \q Que sus mujeres se queden sin hijos y viudas, \q que sus hombres mueran de peste \q y sus jóvenes caigan a espada en la batalla.
es.R: Por eso, deja que sus hijos mueran de hambre. \q Deja que los demás mueran en la guerra. \q Que sus mujeres pierdan a sus hijos y a sus maridos. \q Que sus hombres mueran de enfermedad, \q y que sus jóvenes mueran en la batalla.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi livre {{gender:leurs enfants|leurs fils}} à la famine, \q et livre-les au pouvoir de l’épée. \q Que leurs femmes soient privées d’enfants et veuves, \q que leurs hommes soient tués par la mort, \q leurs jeunes gens frappés par l’épée au combat.
fr.B: Alors livre {{gender:leurs enfants|leurs fils}} à la famine, \q abandonne-les au pouvoir de l’épée. \q Que leurs femmes perdent leurs enfants et leurs maris, \q que leurs hommes meurent de la peste, \q et que leurs jeunes gens tombent sous l’épée au combat.
fr.R: Alors fais mourir de faim {{gender:leurs enfants|leurs fils}}. \q Que les autres soient tués à la guerre. \q Que leurs femmes perdent leurs enfants et leurs maris. \q Que leurs hommes meurent de maladie, \q et que leurs jeunes gens soient tués au combat.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo uwatoe watoto wao kwa njaa, \q uwamwage mikononi mwa upanga. \q Wake zao na wafiwe na watoto na kuwa wajane, \q na wanaume wao wauawe kwa mauti, \q vijana wao wapigwe kwa upanga vitani.
sw.B: Basi uwatoe watoto wao kwa njaa; \q uwaache mikononi mwa upanga. \q Wake zao waachwe bila watoto na wawe wajane, \q wanaume wao wauawe kwa tauni, \q na vijana wao wapigwe kwa upanga vitani.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watoto wao na wafe kwa njaa. \q Wengine wao na wauawe vitani. \q Wake zao na wapoteze watoto wao na waume zao. \q Wanaume wao na wafe kwa magonjwa, \q na vijana wao wauawe vitani.

vi.L: Vì vậy, xin phó con cái chúng cho nạn đói, \q và nộp chúng vào quyền lực của gươm. \q Nguyện vợ chúng mất con và thành góa phụ, \q nguyện đàn ông của chúng bị sự chết giết đi, \q các thanh niên của chúng bị gươm đánh ngã trong trận chiến.
vi.B: Vậy xin phó con cái chúng cho nạn đói; \q xin nộp chúng vào quyền lực của gươm. \q Nguyện vợ chúng mất con và mất chồng, \q đàn ông của chúng chết vì dịch bệnh, \q và các thanh niên của chúng ngã dưới lưỡi gươm nơi chiến trận.
vi.R: Vậy xin để con cái chúng chết đói. \q Xin để những người còn lại bị giết trong chiến tranh. \q Xin để vợ chúng mất cả con lẫn chồng. \q Xin để đàn ông của chúng chết vì bệnh tật, \q và các thanh niên của chúng bị giết nơi chiến trận.

ko.L: 그러므로 그들의 자녀들을 기근에 넘기시고, \q 그들을 칼의 손에 쏟아 버리십시오. \q 그들의 아내들은 자식을 잃고 과부가 되게 하시고, \q 그들의 남자들은 죽음으로 죽임을 당하게 하시고, \q 그들의 젊은이들은 전쟁에서 칼에 맞아 쓰러지게 하십시오.
ko.B: 그러니 그들의 자녀들을 기근에 넘기시고, \q 그들을 칼에 넘겨주십시오. \q 그들의 아내들은 자식을 잃고 과부가 되게 하시고, \q 그들의 남자들은 전염병에 죽게 하시고, \q 그들의 젊은이들은 싸움터에서 칼에 맞아 쓰러지게 하십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 그들의 자녀들이 굶어 죽게 하십시오. \q 나머지 사람들은 전쟁에서 죽게 하십시오. \q 그들의 아내들이 자식과 남편을 잃게 하십시오. \q 그들의 남자들이 병들어 죽게 하시고, \q 그들의 젊은이들이 싸움터에서 죽임을 당하게 하십시오.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's cry for vengeance: an honest prayer that hands judgment over to God
decisions.reason: Verses 21-23 ask God to bring on the plotters the very disasters God himself had announced (14:12, 16; 15:2-3, 7-9). Jeremiah does not take revenge; he gives his case to God, who says that vengeance belongs to him (Deuteronomy 32:35; 11:20). The Bible records such prayers honestly, as the psalms do (Psalm 109; 137:7-9), without making them a pattern for every prayer. Jesus prayed for those who killed him (Luke 23:34), and Paul tells believers not to take revenge but to leave it to God (Romans 12:19).

decisions.choice: hand them over to the power of the sword: let them be killed in war
decisions.reason: The verb means to pour out, here to give someone over helpless. "The hands of the sword" means the power of the sword, that is, of the enemy who uses it.

decisions.choice: slain by death: killed by plague
decisions.reason: "Death" here means deadly disease, as in 15:2, where it stands beside the sword, famine and captivity.

decisions.choice: childless and widows: the whole household lost
decisions.reason: A woman who lost both her children and her husband was left with no one to provide for her or carry on the family. God had warned of exactly this (15:7-8).

decisions.choice: their children, with "their sons" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means children of both sexes here, since it is famine that will take them, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: the rest of them; lose their children and their husbands
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear who is meant in the second line and says what "childless and widows" means.

decisions.choice: sus hijos
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already includes daughters, so it takes no gender span where the English has "their children / their sons", as the terms note sets for Jeremiah 3.

decisions.choice: watoto wao
decisions.reason: "Watoto" includes sons and daughters; Swahili has no second wording that would serve the gender setting, so there is no span here.

decisions.choice: "leurs enfants", with "leurs fils" as the gender alternative
decisions.reason: As the English: the famine takes children of both sexes, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: "con cái" (children), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Con cái" already covers sons and daughters and is the plain word for a household's children; the English gender alternative "their sons" has no separate Vietnamese wording worth a setting.

decisions.choice: "자녀들", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons" means the children here; Korean "자녀들" is the plain word and the English alternative "sons" would add nothing a Korean reader needs, so there is no setting span.

source.text: תִּשָּׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ מִבָּ֣תֵּיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־תָבִ֧יא עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם גְּד֖וּד פִּתְאֹ֑ם כִּֽי־כָר֤וּ שׁוּחָה֙ לְלָכְדֵ֔נִי וּפַחִ֖ים טָמְנ֥וּ לְרַגְלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Let be heard a cry from their houses, when you bring upon them a raiding band suddenly; for they have dug a pit to capture me, and snares they have hidden for my feet.

en.L: Let a cry be heard from their houses, \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring a raiding band upon them suddenly; \q for they have dug a pit to capture me, \q and they have hidden snares for my feet.
en.B: Let screams ring out from their houses \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring raiders on them without warning, \q for they have dug a pit to catch me \q and hidden traps for my feet.
en.R: Let people hear screams coming from their houses \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} suddenly send raiders to attack them. \q They have dug a pit to catch me. \q They have hidden traps along my path.

es.L: Que se oiga un grito desde sus casas, \q cuando traigas sobre ellos de repente una banda de saqueadores; \q porque han cavado una fosa para atraparme, \q y han escondido trampas para mis pies.
es.B: Que se oigan gritos desde sus casas \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} traigas sobre ellos saqueadores sin aviso, \q porque han cavado una fosa para atraparme \q y han escondido lazos para mis pies.
es.R: Que la gente oiga gritos que salen de sus casas \q cuando de repente {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} envíes saqueadores contra ellos. \q Ellos han cavado una fosa para atraparme. \q Han escondido trampas en mi camino.

fr.L: Qu’un cri soit entendu de leurs maisons, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} feras venir sur eux soudain une troupe de pillards ; \q car ils ont creusé une fosse pour me prendre, \q et ils ont caché des pièges pour mes pieds.
fr.B: Que des cris s’élèvent de leurs maisons \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} feras venir sur eux des pillards sans prévenir, \q car ils ont creusé une fosse pour me prendre \q et caché des pièges sous mes pieds.
fr.R: Que l’on entende des cris dans leurs maisons \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enverras tout à coup des pillards pour les attaquer. \q Car ils ont creusé un trou pour m’attraper. \q Ils ont caché des pièges sur mon chemin.

sw.L: Kilio na kisikike kutoka nyumba zao, \q utakapoleta kikosi cha wavamizi juu yao ghafula; \q kwa maana wamechimba shimo ili kunikamata, \q nao wameficha mitego kwa ajili ya miguu yangu.
sw.B: Mayowe na yasikike kutoka nyumba zao \q utakapowaletea wavamizi bila kutarajia, \q kwa maana wamechimba shimo ili kuninasa \q na kuficha mitego ya miguu yangu.
sw.R: Watu na wasikie mayowe yakitoka katika nyumba zao \q utakapowatuma wavamizi kuwashambulia ghafla. \q Wamechimba shimo ili kuninasa. \q Wameficha mitego katika njia yangu.

vi.L: Nguyện có tiếng kêu la vang lên từ nhà chúng, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thình lình đem một toán cướp đến trên chúng; \q vì chúng đã đào hố để bắt con, \q và đã giấu bẫy dưới chân con.
vi.B: Nguyện tiếng la hét vang ra từ nhà chúng \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thình lình đem quân cướp đến trên chúng, \q vì chúng đã đào hố để bắt con \q và giấu bẫy dưới chân con.
vi.R: Xin cho người ta nghe tiếng la hét từ nhà chúng \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thình lình sai quân cướp đến tấn công chúng. \q Chúng đã đào hố để bắt con. \q Chúng đã giấu bẫy trên đường con đi.

ko.L: 주님께서 갑자기 그들에게 약탈하는 무리를 데려오실 때에 \q 그들의 집에서 부르짖는 소리가 들리게 하십시오. \q 그들이 저를 잡으려고 구덩이를 팠고, \q 제 발을 걸려고 올무를 숨겨 놓았기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 갑자기 그들에게 약탈자들을 보내실 때에 \q 그들의 집집마다 비명 소리가 터져 나오게 하십시오. \q 그들이 저를 잡으려고 구덩이를 파고, \q 제 발 앞에 덫을 숨겨 놓았습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 갑자기 약탈자들을 보내어 그들을 치실 때에 \q 그들의 집에서 비명 소리가 들리게 하십시오. \q 그들은 저를 잡으려고 구덩이를 팠습니다. \q 제가 가는 길에 덫을 숨겨 놓았습니다.

decisions.choice: a raiding band: a troop of armed raiders
decisions.reason: The word is used of bands that made sudden attacks to plunder (2 Kings 5:2; 13:20; 24:2). The cry from the houses is the cry of people caught by surprise.

decisions.choice: a pit and snares: hunters' traps
decisions.reason: As in verse 20, Jeremiah pictures the plot as a hunt, with a covered pit and hidden snares laid where he would walk (Psalm 140:6; 142:4). The written text spells "pit" with a different vowel letter from the text as read; both mean a pit.

decisions.choice: let a cry be heard: part of Jeremiah's cry for vengeance
decisions.reason: See verse 21, meaning decision m1.

decisions.choice: along my path
decisions.reason: "For my feet" means where Jeremiah would step. Readable says "along my path".

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֠הוָה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲצָתָ֤ם עָלַי֙ לַמָּ֔וֶת אַל־תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־עֲוֺנָ֔ם וְחַטָּאתָ֖ם מִלְּפָנֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּ֑מְחִי וְיִהְי֤וּ מֻכְשָׁלִים֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ בְּעֵ֥ת אַפְּךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֥ה בָהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But you, Yahweh, know all their counsel against me for death. Do not cover over their iniquity, and their sin from before you do not blot out; and let them be made to stumble before you; in [the] time of your anger deal with them.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, know all their counsel against me to kill [me]. \q Do not cover over their iniquity, \q and do not blot out their sin from before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Let them be made to stumble before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q in the time of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger deal with them.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, know all their plans to kill me. \q Do not forgive their guilt \q or wipe out their sin from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight. \q Let them be brought down before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q act against them in the time of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, know all about their plans to kill me. \q Do not forgive their sin. \q Do not erase the wrong they have done from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight. \q Let them fall down in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Punish them while {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, conoces todo su consejo contra mí para muerte. \q No cubras su iniquidad, \q ni borres su pecado de delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Que sean hechos tropezar delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q en el tiempo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira actúa contra ellos.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, conoces todos sus planes para matarme. \q No perdones su culpa \q ni borres su pecado de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vista. \q Que caigan derribados delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q actúa contra ellos en el tiempo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sabes muy bien que planean matarme. \q No les perdones su pecado. \q No borres de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vista el mal que han hecho. \q Que caigan delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Castígalos mientras estés enojado.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais tout leur dessein contre moi pour [me] faire mourir. \q Ne couvre pas leur iniquité, \q et n’efface pas leur péché de devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Qu’ils soient renversés devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q au temps de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, agis contre eux.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais tous leurs projets pour me tuer. \q Ne pardonne pas leur faute, \q n’efface pas leur péché de devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face. \q Qu’ils tombent devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q agis contre eux au temps de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais tout de leurs projets pour me tuer. \q Ne leur pardonne pas leur péché. \q N’efface pas de devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} le mal qu’ils ont fait. \q Qu’ils tombent devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Punis-les quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} seras en colère.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unajua shauri lao lote dhidi yangu la kuniua. \q Usiusitiri uovu wao, \q wala usiifute dhambi yao mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Na wakwazwe mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q utende nao wakati wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unaijua mipango yao yote ya kuniua. \q Usiusamehe uovu wao, \q wala usiifute dhambi yao machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}. \q Waangushwe mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q uwashughulikie wakati wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unajua yote kuhusu mipango yao ya kuniua. \q Usiwasamehe dhambi yao. \q Usiyafute makosa waliyofanya mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Waanguke mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Uwaadhibu wakati ukiwa na hasira.

vi.L: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết mọi mưu kế của chúng nghịch cùng con để giết [con]. \q Xin đừng che lấp tội ác chúng, \q và đừng xóa tội lỗi chúng khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Nguyện chúng bị vấp ngã trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q xin xử chúng trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.
vi.B: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết mọi mưu kế chúng định giết con. \q Xin đừng tha thứ tội ác chúng, \q cũng đừng xóa tội lỗi chúng khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Nguyện chúng bị đánh ngã trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q xin ra tay nghịch cùng chúng trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết rõ mọi mưu kế chúng định giết con. \q Xin đừng tha tội cho chúng. \q Xin đừng xóa những điều sai trái chúng đã làm khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin cho chúng ngã xuống trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Xin phạt chúng trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 저를 대적하여 죽음에 [이르게 하려는] 그들의 모든 계략을 아십니다. \q 그들의 죄악을 덮어 주지 마시고, \q 그들의 죄를 주님 앞에서 지워 버리지 마십시오. \q 그들이 주님 앞에서 걸려 넘어지게 하시고, \q 주님께서 노하실 때에 그들을 처리하십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 저를 죽이려는 그들의 계획을 다 아십니다. \q 그들의 허물을 용서하지 마시고, \q 그들의 죄를 주님 앞에서 지워 버리지 마십시오. \q 그들이 주님 앞에서 쓰러지게 하시고, \q 주님께서 노하실 때에 그들을 벌하십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 그들이 저를 죽이려고 세운 계획을 모두 아십니다. \q 그들의 죄를 용서하지 마십시오. \q 그들이 저지른 잘못을 주님 앞에서 지우지 마십시오. \q 그들이 주님 앞에서 넘어지게 하십시오. \q 주님께서 화가 나셨을 때에 그들을 벌하십시오.

decisions.choice: do not cover over their iniquity: do not forgive it
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for making atonement. With God as subject it means to cover over or wipe away guilt (Isaiah 6:7; 22:14). Jeremiah asks that their guilt stay on record before God.

decisions.choice: do not cover ... do not blot out: the same prayer as Nehemiah's
decisions.reason: Nehemiah prays in almost the same words against those who mocked the rebuilding of Jerusalem (Nehemiah 3:37). To blot out sin is to wipe it from God's record (Psalm 51:3; Isaiah 43:25).

decisions.choice: let them be made to stumble: let them fall
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 15, where the idols made the people stumble on their ways. Those who stumbled away from God are to be brought down before him.

decisions.choice: deal with them in the time of your anger: part of Jeremiah's cry for vengeance
decisions.reason: See verse 21, meaning decision m1. The prayer ends by leaving the plotters in God's hands, to be dealt with when he judges.

decisions.choice: iniquity, sin (Literal); guilt, sin (Balanced); sin, the wrong they have done (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording settled for these two words in the prophets (see Isaiah), with Readable using two plain phrases for the pair.

decisions.choice: to kill [me]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "for death". Literal supplies "me" in brackets; Balanced and Readable say "plans to kill me".

decisions.choice: iniquidad, pecado (Literal); culpa, pecado (Balanced); pecado, el mal que han hecho (Readable)
decisions.reason: The two words for wrongdoing keep distinct Spanish words at each level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "iniquité, péché" (L); "faute, péché" (B); "péché, le mal qu'ils ont fait" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair as the English settles it for the prophets.

decisions.choice: "Nhưng lạy CHÚA, Ngài biết ..."
decisions.reason: Vietnamese puts the vocative before the clause; the emphatic "you" is kept as "chính Ngài" at Literal and as a plain "Ngài" at the head of the clause at Balanced and Readable.
